#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Score issue #22 repros with returned rows, logs, and explicit expectations."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
from dataclasses import asdict
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
SOURCE_FILES = (
    "evolution/benchmark/adapter.py",
    "evolution/benchmark/flashinfer_bench_evolve/benchmark_common.py",
    "evolution/benchmark/flashinfer_bench_evolve/tasks/fp16_gemm_floor/benchmark.py",
    "evolution/benchmark/flashinfer_bench_evolve/tasks/fp16_gemm_floor/baseline.py",
    "evolution/benchmark/flashinfer_bench_evolve/tasks/fp16_gemm_floor/workload.jsonl",
    "evolution/tasks/fp16_gemm_floor.yaml",
)

def sha256(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def command(argv):
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        return {"command": argv, "returncode": result.returncode,
                "stdout": result.stdout.strip(), "stderr": result.stderr.strip()}
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        return {"command": argv, "error": str(exc)}

def json_safe(value):
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: json_safe(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [json_safe(item) for item in value]
    return value

def write_json(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(json_safe(value), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

class Tee:
    def __init__(self, console, logfile):
        self.console, self.logfile = console, logfile
    def write(self, text):
        self.console.write(text)
        self.logfile.write(text)
        self.flush()
        return len(text)
    def flush(self):
        self.console.flush()
        self.logfile.flush()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", choices=("baseline", "race_a", "race_b", "sync_a", "sync_b"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--threshold", choices=("task", "legacy", "new"), default="task",
                        help="task reads source; legacy/new override only this process to .99/.9999")
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:0")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True,
                        help="New directory; contains stdout.log, stderr.log, results.json")
    parser.add_argument("--expect", choices=("auto", "pass", "reject", "observe"), default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true", help="Validate paths/config without running CUDA")
    parser.add_argument("--preflight-only", action="store_true", help="Check B200/toolchain without scoring")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    outdir = args.output.resolve()
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    report = {"candidate": args.candidate, "threshold_mode": args.threshold,
              "output": str(outdir), "python": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(),
              "harness_git": command(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]),
              "source_sha256": {name: sha256(ROOT / name) for name in SOURCE_FILES},
              "candidate_manifest_sha256": sha256(HERE / "candidate_manifest.json")}
    start = time.monotonic()
    exit_code = 2
    with (outdir / "stdout.log").open("w", buffering=1) as stdout, (outdir / "stderr.log").open("w", buffering=1) as stderr:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(Tee(sys.stdout, stdout)), contextlib.redirect_stderr(Tee(sys.stderr, stderr)):
            try:
                # Fix the complete default protocol so inherited BENCH knobs cannot
                # silently select one shape or disable important correctness gates.
                protocol = {
                    "BENCH_DEVICE": args.device, "BENCH_WARMUP": "10", "BENCH_ITERS": "50",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One scoring per candidate/threshold; inspect durations before adding repeats."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True, help="A new batch directory")
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:0")
    parser.add_argument("--candidates", nargs="+", choices=("race_a", "race_b", "sync_a", "sync_b"),
                        default=("race_a", "race_b", "sync_a", "sync_b"))
    parser.add_argument("--thresholds", nargs="+", choices=("legacy", "new", "task"),
                        default=("legacy", "task"))
    parser.add_argument("--skip-baseline", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--include-legacy-sync", action="store_true",
                        help="Also score restored-sync kernels at .99; omitted by default")
    parser.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    cases = ([] if args.skip_baseline else [("baseline", "task")])
    cases += [(candidate, threshold) for threshold in args.thresholds for candidate in args.candidates
              if threshold != "legacy" or candidate.startswith("race_") or args.include_legacy_sync]
    index = {"cases": [], "note": "Exactly one scoring per case; no automatic repetitions.",
             "plan_only": args.plan_only}
    failed = False
    for candidate, threshold in cases:
        resultdir = output / (candidate + "_" + threshold)
        cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "gpu_validate.py"), "--candidate", candidate,
               "--threshold", threshold, "--device", args.device, "--output", str(resultdir)]
        if args.plan_only:
            cmd.append("--plan-only")
        start = time.monotonic()
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd)
        resultpath = resultdir / "results.json"
        result = json.loads(resultpath.read_text()) if resultpath.exists() else {}
        index["cases"].append({
            "candidate": candidate, "threshold": threshold, "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - start,
            "results": str(resultpath), "status": result.get("status"),
            "summary": result.get("summary"),
        })
        (output / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2) + "\n")
        failed |= proc.returncode != 0
        if proc.returncode == 2:
            index["stopped_on_infrastructure_error"] = True
            (output / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2) + "\n")
            break
    print(json.dumps(index, indent=2))
    return 1 if failed else 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import tirx_kernels.tirx_lite as txl
from tirx_kernels.runner import compile_kernel, cuda_target


def _make_kernel(M, N, K):
    TM = 64
    TN = 128
    TK = 64
    A_STRIDE = 72
    B_STRIDE = 136
    WARPS = 8
    THREADS = WARPS * 32

    tiles_m = M // TM
    tiles_n = N // TN
    tiles_k = K // TK

    MMA = "mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16.row.col.f32.f16.f16.f32"
    LDMATRIX_A = "ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x4.shared.b16"
    LDMATRIX_B = "ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x2.trans.shared.b16"
    LD_G_V4 = "ld.global.v4.b32"
    ST_S_V4 = "st.shared.v4.b32"
    CVT_F16X2 = "cvt.rn.f16x2.f32"

    @txl.kernel(
        warps=WARPS,
        arch="sm_100a",
        grid=tiles_m * tiles_n,
    )
    def gemm(
        a: txl.gptr(txl.f16),
        b: txl.gptr(txl.f16),
        d: txl.gptr(txl.f16),
    ):
        tid = txl.thread_id()
        warp = tid >> 5
        lane = tid & 31
        cta = txl.cta_id()

        tile_m = cta // tiles_n
        tile_n = cta - tile_m * tiles_n

        # Two warp rows and four warp columns. Each warp computes 32x32.
        warp_m = warp >> 2
        warp_n = warp & 3

        smem = txl.smem_pool()
        a_smem = smem.alloc([TM, A_STRIDE], txl.f16)

        # B is explicitly staged as the logical KxN matrix. This makes the
        # x2.trans ldmatrix fragment exactly the column-major B operand expected
        # by mma.m16n8k16.
        b_smem = smem.alloc([TK, B_STRIDE], txl.f16)

        io = txl.alloc_local([4], "uint32")
        bbits = txl.local_scalar("uint16")
        ar = txl.alloc_local([8], "uint32")
        br = txl.alloc_local([8], "uint32")
        acc = txl.alloc_local([32], "float32")
        packed = txl.local_scalar("uint32")

        for i in range(32):
            txl.assign(acc[i], txl.float32(0.0))

        def sync():
            txl.ptx.bar.sync(txl.uint32(0), txl.uint32(THREADS))

        with txl.serial(tiles_k) as kt:
            k_base = kt * TK

            # Stage the 64x64 A tile with aligned 128-bit transactions.
            for q in range(2):
                vec = tid + q * THREADS
                load_row = vec >> 3
                load_k = (vec & 7) << 3
                global_row = tile_m * TM + load_row

                txl.ptx[LD_G_V4](
                    io[0],
                    io[1],
                    io[2],
                    io[3],
                    a.ptr_to([
                        txl.Cast(
                            "int64",
                            global_row * K + k_base + load_k,
                        )
                    ]),
                )
                txl.ptx[ST_S_V4](
                    a_smem.ptr_to([load_row, load_k]),
                    io[0],
                    io[1],
                    io[2],
                    io[3],
                )

            # Input B is laid out [N,K]. Threads vary along K so each warp's
            # global accesses remain contiguous, while stores transpose the
            # tile into shared-memory [K,N].
            for q in range(32):
                linear = tid + q * THREADS
                load_n = linear >> 6
                load_k = linear & 63
                global_n = tile_n * TN + load_n

                txl.ptx["ld.global.b16"](
                    bbits,
                    b.ptr_to([
                        txl.Cast(
                            "int64",
                            global_n * K + k_base + load_k,
                        )
                    ]),
                )
                txl.ptx["st.shared.b16"](
                    b_smem.ptr_to([load_k, load_n]),
                    bbits,
                )

            sync()

            for kp in range(4):
                sk = kp * 16

                # A is row-major. x4 loads the four 8x8 quadrants of each
                # 16x16 A fragment in the register order consumed by MMA.
                for mi in range(2):
                    a_row = (
                        warp_m * 32
                        + mi * 16
                        + (lane & 7)
                        + ((lane >> 3) & 1) * 8
                    )
                    a_col = sk + (lane >> 4) * 8
                    ai = mi * 4

                    txl.ptx[LDMATRIX_A](
                        ar[ai + 0],
                        ar[ai + 1],
                        ar[ai + 2],
                        ar[ai + 3],
                        a_smem.ptr_to([a_row, a_col]),
                    )

                # Each physical B fragment is 16 rows (K) by 8 columns (N).
                # The transposed ldmatrix form supplies the column-major MMA B
                # operand. Only lanes 0..15 provide addresses for x2.
                for nj in range(4):
                    b_row = sk + (lane & 15)
                    b_col = warp_n * 32 + nj * 8
                    bi = nj * 2

                    txl.ptx[LDMATRIX_B](
                        br[bi + 0],
                        br[bi + 1],
                        b_smem.ptr_to([b_row, b_col]),
                    )

                for mi in range(2):
                    ai = mi * 4
                    for nj in range(4):
                        bi = nj * 2
                        ci = (mi * 4 + nj) * 4

                        txl.ptx[MMA](
                            acc[ci + 0],
                            acc[ci + 1],
                            acc[ci + 2],
                            acc[ci + 3],
                            ar[ai + 0],
                            ar[ai + 1],
                            ar[ai + 2],
                            ar[ai + 3],
                            br[bi + 0],
                            br[bi + 1],
                            acc[ci + 0],
                            acc[ci + 1],
                            acc[ci + 2],
                            acc[ci + 3],
                        )

            pass  # removed here: sync(), the bar.sync at the end of the K loop

        # m16n8 accumulator ownership:
        #   d0,d1 -> row lane/4,     columns 2*(lane%4) + {0,1}
        #   d2,d3 -> row lane/4 + 8, columns 2*(lane%4) + {0,1}
        lane_row = lane >> 2
        lane_col = (lane & 3) << 1

        for mi in range(2):
            row0 = tile_m * TM + warp_m * 32 + mi * 16 + lane_row
            row1 = row0 + 8

            for nj in range(4):
                out_col = (
                    tile_n * TN
                    + warp_n * 32
                    + nj * 8
                    + lane_col
                )
                ci = (mi * 4 + nj) * 4

                txl.ptx[CVT_F16X2](
                    packed,
                    acc[ci + 1],
                    acc[ci + 0],
                )
                txl.ptx["st.global.b32"](
                    d.ptr_to([
                        txl.Cast("int64", row0 * N + out_col)
                    ]),
                    packed,
                )
